title: .spec-drive-config.json
description: Scoped Spec-Drive configuration contract for workspace-local topology, portable project identity, and supported legacy unscoped compatibility.

safeProjectSlug.description: Safe project directory slug. Must not be empty, '.' or '..', and must contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen.

relativeProjectsPath.description: Relative path from workspaceRoot to the projects container. Runtime enforcement must canonicalize this path under workspaceRoot and reject escapes.

projectConfig.title: Project Scope
projectConfig.description: Portable project-root config. Carries project identity and portable overrides only; no workspace topology keys are allowed.

scope.description: Marks this config as project scoped.

workspaceConfig.title: Workspace Scope
workspaceConfig.description: Node-local workspace config. Declares topology separately from project identity.

scope.description: Marks this config as workspace scoped.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root for this node. Absolute or config-relative values are resolved by runtime.

legacyConfig.title: Legacy Unscoped
legacyConfig.description: Legacy unscoped compatibility shape accepted for workspace or XDG fallback. This shape is supported for migration only and is never generated for new projects.

projectRoot.description: Legacy project container path. Relative values resolve from the config file directory.
